name: Zapier
verdict_reason: Activepieces runs your automations on your box with a visual builder and hundreds of pieces. Zapier's task-based pricing means success gets expensive; self-hosted, a busy month costs the same as a quiet one.
what_you_lose: Zapier's long tail of 6000+ integrations — check your critical apps against the pieces list first
Their reliability team; failed runs are now your logs to read

what_broke: First boot syncs its pieces catalog over the network — in a proxied/airgapped environment that sync fails and the API never comes up; plan for npm egress on first start
Not boot-verified in this session — compose is CI-gated (weekly compose-check must pass before this claim hardens)
